# DEV Community
> A community platform where software developers publish posts, discuss technology, learn new skills, and grow their careers.

DEV Community is a Forem-powered social publishing site for developers. It combines user-generated articles, tag-based topic hubs, videos, education tracks, challenges, organization profiles, and community policies in one place.

## Core Platform
- [DEV Community](https://dev.to/): Main community feed for developer posts, discussions, tags, and discovery.
- [About](https://dev.to/about): Overview of DEV, its mission, community model, and platform background.
- [Contact](https://dev.to/contact): Contact options for support, questions, partnerships, and general inquiries.
- [DEV Help](https://dev.to/help): Help center covering account usage, posting, moderation, and platform features.
- [DEV++](https://dev.to/++): Membership program with paid benefits and ways to support the platform.

## Content Discovery
- [Posts](https://dev.to/latest): Latest published posts from across the DEV Community.
- [Videos](https://dev.to/videos): Video content for programming, tools, tutorials, and developer education.
- [DEV Education Tracks](https://dev.to/deved): Structured learning tracks and educational content for developers.
- [DEV Challenges](https://dev.to/challenges): Community challenges and hackathon-style events for writing and building.
- [DEV Showcase](https://dev.to/showcase): Showcase of products, tools, and community projects featured on DEV.

## Popular Tags
- [#webdev](https://dev.to/t/webdev): Web development articles, tutorials, tools, frameworks, and frontend or backend practices.
- [#ai](https://dev.to/t/ai): Artificial intelligence discussions, experiments, tutorials, and developer workflows.
- [#programming](https://dev.to/t/programming): General programming posts spanning languages, concepts, and software engineering.
- [#javascript](https://dev.to/t/javascript): JavaScript tutorials, ecosystem updates, and practical coding techniques.
- [#opensource](https://dev.to/t/opensource): Open source projects, contribution stories, and community collaboration.
- [#rails](https://dev.to/t/rails): Ruby on Rails articles, patterns, tooling, and application development tips.

## Community Programs
- [Organization Accounts](https://dev.to/organizations): Organization profiles for teams publishing content and engaging developers.
- [Advertise on DEV](https://dev.to/advertise): Advertising and sponsorship options for reaching the developer audience.
- [Free Postgres Database](https://dev.to/free-postgres-database-tier): Promotional resource page for a free Postgres database offering.
- [Forem](https://www.forem.com): Platform behind DEV for building independent community sites.
- [Forem Shop](https://shop.forem.com/): Merchandise store for Forem and DEV-related products.
- [MLH](https://mlh.io/): External partner site linked from DEV community navigation.

## Participation & Support
- [Sign In / Create Account](https://dev.to/enter): Entry point for authentication, account creation, and community participation.
- [Home Feed](https://dev.to/): Personalized and global feed for reading and engaging with posts.
- [DEV Help](https://dev.to/help): Guidance for using DEV features, troubleshooting, and finding support resources.
- [Contact](https://dev.to/contact): Reach the DEV team for support, feedback, and business inquiries.

## Policies
- [Code of Conduct](https://dev.to/code-of-conduct): Community behavior standards and moderation expectations for participation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dev.to/privacy): Details on data collection, usage, and privacy practices.
- [Terms of Use](https://dev.to/terms): Legal terms governing use of the DEV platform and services.

## Ecosystem
- [DEV Community](https://dev.to/): Primary developer community site on the Forem platform.
- [Forem](https://www.forem.com): Open community platform used to power DEV and similar sites.
- [Open Source Tag](https://dev.to/t/opensource): DEV’s open source topic hub and related community content.
- [Ruby on Rails Tag](https://dev.to/t/rails): Rails-focused content frequently associated with the platform’s ecosystem.
